newsitem.title: USA: BPA leaves Wed surplus power prices unchanged.
newsitem.headline: BPA leaves Wed surplus power prices unchanged.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) left offer prices for surplus power delivered on Wednesday unchanged, the agency said Tuesday.
BPA still offered up to 300 megawatts of firm peak power, at $14.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest sales and $15.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales.
Prices for non-firm power during shoulder hours on Wednesday (0600, 1100-1700 and 2100-2200 PST) were unchanged at $12.00 per MWh for Northwest sales and $13.00 for COB.
BPA continued to refrain from offering non-firm power during morning and evening peaks or any displacement power.
Prices for firm and non-firm power during off-peak hours on Wednesday were unchanged at $9.00 per MWh for all deliveries.
